title: Optimal-order mixing of the Thorp shuffle
summary: We prove that the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards mixes in $`\Theta(d)`$ complete shuffles. The full permutation law after $`1600d`$ shuffles converges to uniform in total variation as $`d\to\infty`$, uniformly over the initial deck, while a support count gives a lower bound of $`2d-O(1)`$.
